title: Laila Small Pebbled Leather Satchel
description_html:
Laila Small Pebbled Leather Satchel by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 10”W X 7.25”H X 4.75”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 3.5”
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
